_comment: Cross-driver diagnostic snapshot contract (SPEC.md section 12). Every driver logs exactly one INFO line built from these fields, in this order, once boot completes. Replayed by windows/tests/unit/test_diagnostic_snapshot.ahk, macos/tests/unit/lib/test_diagnostic_snapshot.lua, linux/tests/unit/infra/test_diagnostic_snapshot.lua and tools/test/test-diagnostic-snapshot-parity.cjs.
_format: 'Diagnostic snapshot (' + fields joined by one space + ').'. Each field renders as name=value. A missing or empty value renders as the unknown token. CR, LF and TAB become one space, a double quote becomes a single quote, and a value that then contains a space is wrapped in double quotes.

vectors.description: Every field present; spaces force quoting.
vectors.expected: Diagnostic snapshot (driver=windows version=3.1.0 commit=3b924cd46 os="Windows 11 Home" os_version=26100.4652 arch=x64 runtime="AutoHotkey 2.0.19" elevated=false locale=fr keyboard_layout=0x040C040C monitors=2 dpi=144 display=win32 config_dir=~/config/ergopti_plus log_level=DEBUG features_enabled=42/97 boot_ms=812).

vectors.description: Absent and empty values render as the unknown token, never as an empty field.
vectors.expected: Diagnostic snapshot (driver=linux version=3.0.0 commit=unknown os=Ubuntu os_version=24.04 arch=x86_64 runtime="LuaJIT 2.1" elevated=false locale=en keyboard_layout=unknown monitors=1 dpi=unknown display="wayland GNOME" config_dir=~/.config/ergopti log_level=INFO features_enabled=3/5 boot_ms=120).

vectors.description: Line breaks, tabs and double quotes cannot break the one-line shape.
vectors.expected: Diagnostic snapshot (driver=macos version=3.1.0 commit=abc1234 os="macOS 15.5" os_version=15.5 arch=arm64 runtime="Hammerspoon '1.0.0'" elevated=false locale=fr keyboard_layout=com.apple.keylayout.French monitors=1 dpi=2 display=quartz config_dir="~/Library/Ergopti Plus" log_level=DEBUG features_enabled=10/12 boot_ms=950).
